new.x: Lake Titicaca is shared by Peru and Bolivia.

new.s: Which country is known as the 'Land of a Thousand Lakes'?
new.x: Finland has about 1.88 lakh glacial lakes and is called the Land of a Thousand Lakes.

new.s: Which waterway connects Lake Superior with Lake Huron?
new.x: The St Marys River and the Soo Canal link Lake Superior with Lake Huron.

new.s: Which water bodies does the Panama Canal connect?
o: Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean Sea
new.x: The Panama Canal crosses the Isthmus of Panama, linking the Caribbean (Atlantic) with the Pacific.

new.s: Which strait is known as the 'Gate of Tears'?
new.x: Bab-el-Mandeb, linking the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, means 'Gate of Tears'.

new.s: To which country does Greenland, the largest island of the world, belong?
new.x: Greenland has been under Denmark since 1380, though it lies geographically in North America.

new.s: Which is the only landlocked country of South-East Asia?
new.x: Laos is the only landlocked country in South-East Asia.

new.s: Which country is called the 'Emerald Isle'?
new.x: Ireland's mild, wet oceanic climate keeps it green, so it is called the Emerald Isle.

new.s: In which State is Roopkund, the glacial 'Skeleton Lake', located?
new.x: Roopkund, the mystery or skeleton lake, is a glacial lake of Uttarakhand.

new.s: With which country does India share its longest land border?
new.x: India's border with Bangladesh (4,096.7 km) is its longest; China comes second.

new.s: Which of the following shows India's neighbours in descending order of land-border length?
new.x: Bangladesh (4,096.7 km) > China (3,488 km) > Pakistan (3,323 km) > Nepal (1,751 km).

new.s: Which two neighbouring countries share only maritime borders with India?
new.x: Sri Lanka and the Maldives touch India only by sea.
new.angle: U0622 #1 sea-border neighbours; PYQ y7120e94b4cf angle

new.s: Which southern State shares its borders with the largest number of States?
new.x: Karnataka borders Goa, Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

new.s: What is the longitude of the Indian Standard Meridian?
new.x: The Indian Standard Meridian is 82°30′ E, passing near Mirzapur; IST is UTC + 5:30.

new.s: Through which of the following groups of States does the Indian Standard Meridian pass?
o: Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha and Andhra Pradesh
Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu
Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
new.x: From north to south the meridian crosses UP, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha and AP.

new.s: Between which longitudes does India extend?
new.x: India lies between 68°7′ E and 97°25′ E longitude.

new.s: In which year was the McMahon Line drawn at the Simla Convention?
new.x: The McMahon Line was fixed at the Simla Convention of 3 July 1914 between Britain and Tibet.

new.s: The Durand Line, drawn in 1893, separated British India from which country?
new.x: Sir Mortimer Durand drew the line between British India and Afghanistan; it now divides Pakistan and Afghanistan.

new.s: Sir Creek, a tidal estuary in the Rann of Kutch, is disputed between India and which country?
new.x: Sir Creek lies between Gujarat and Sindh and is an India-Pakistan dispute.

new.s: Which State has the longest coastline in India?
new.x: Gujarat has the longest coastline, followed by Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: Which Indian State shares borders with China, Nepal and Bhutan?
new.x: Sikkim touches China, Nepal and Bhutan.

new.s: In which country is the Gwadar Port located?
new.x: Gwadar Port, on the Arabian Sea in Balochistan, is in Pakistan and was developed with China.
new.angle: U0622 PYQ yf5c76599039 / ye83949db3e6 feature -> neighbouring country angle

new.s: In which State does the Siliguri corridor, known as the 'Chicken's Neck', lie?
new.x: The 20-22 km wide Siliguri corridor in West Bengal links the North-East with the rest of India.
new.angle: U0622 PYQ y655f2eeebb4 chicken's neck angle

new.s: Which of the following countries does NOT share a border with Afghanistan?
new.x: Afghanistan borders Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, China, India, Pakistan and Iran, but not Russia.
new.angle: U0622 #1 neighbours of neighbours; notes gap

new.s: Which channel separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands?
new.x: The Ten Degree Channel, about 150 km wide along 10° N, lies between the Andamans and the Nicobars.

new.s: The India-Pakistan boundary is an example of which type of boundary?
new.x: It was drawn by an outside power (the British) at Partition, so it is a superimposed boundary.

new.s: Between which two ranges does the Kullu Valley lie?
new.x: The Kullu Valley of Himachal Pradesh lies between the Dhauladhar and Pir Panjal ranges.
new.angle: U0623 #3 valley -> range; PYQ y2b4e608208f angle

new.s: Between which ranges does the Kashmir Valley lie?
new.x: The Kashmir Valley lies in the Himachal zone, between the Great Himalaya (north-east) and the Pir Panjal (south-west).
new.angle: U0623 #3 valley -> range; PYQ y5eaabaf408a angle

new.s: Which crop is grown on the karewa soils of the Kashmir Himalaya?
new.x: Karewas are lake terraces of the Kashmir Valley whose soils are used for zafran (saffron).

new.s: By what other name is the Lesser Himalaya known?
new.x: The Lesser or Middle Himalaya is called the Himachal; the Greater is the Himadri and the Outer is the Shiwalik.
new.angle: U0623 #2 local names of ranges; PYQ y3e02e7f8ee1 angle

new.s: Which of the following shows the correct sequence of passes from west to east?
o: Shipki La, Zoji La, Lipulekh, Nathu La
Zoji La, Lipulekh, Shipki La, Nathu La
Zoji La, Shipki La, Lipulekh, Nathu La
Shipki La, Zoji La, Nathu La, Lipulekh
new.x: Zoji La (Ladakh), Shipki La (Himachal), Lipulekh (Uttarakhand) and Nathu La (Sikkim) lie in that order from west to east.

new.s: Which pass lies on the Srinagar-Leh route?
new.x: Zoji La carries the Srinagar-Leh road (NH-1); Baralacha La is on the Manali-Leh road.

new.s: In which district is the Lipulekh Pass, on the Kailash-Mansarovar route, located?
new.x: Lipulekh is in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, near the India-Nepal-China tri-junction.

new.s: In which year was Nathu La reopened for India-China trade?
new.x: Nathu La, closed after 1962, was reopened for trade in 2006.

new.s: Which of the following glaciers is the longest?
new.x: In decreasing length: Hispar > Biafo > Drang Drung > Sonapani > Bara Shigri.

new.s: In which hills does Nokrek Peak lie?
new.x: Nokrek Peak is in the Garo Hills of Meghalaya.
new.angle: U0623 #6 Purvanchal hills; PYQ yc24f51d1dab hills angle

new.s: Which is the highest range of Assam?
new.x: The Barail Range, linking the Naga and Mizo hills, is the highest range of Assam.

new.s: Which of the following States is NOT touched by the Patkai hills?
new.x: The Patkai hills touch Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram and Nagaland, but not Tripura.

new.s: Which hills form the meeting point of the Western and Eastern Ghats?
new.x: The two Ghats meet in the Nilgiri Hills, at the junction of Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Ten Degree Channel separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands.
2. The Eight Degree Channel separates Minicoy from the Maldives.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Ten Degree Channel lies between the Andamans and Nicobars, and the Eight Degree Channel between Minicoy and the Maldives.

new.s: In which State is the Molassis Basin located?
new.x: The Molassis Basin of soft, loose deposits lies in Mizoram in the Purvanchal.

new.s: Which is the largest and oldest physiographic division of India?
new.x: The Peninsular Plateau, a part of Gondwana Land, is the largest and oldest division; the Northern Plains are the youngest.

new.s: The Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary is located in which region?
new.x: The Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary lies in the Rann of Kutch, Gujarat.

new.s: Who are the Agariyas of the Little Rann of Kutch?
new.x: The Agariyas are the traditional salt-pan workers of the Little Rann.
new.angle: U0624 #6 Rann of Kutch; notes gap

new.s: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
new.x: The Kosi forms a huge shifting alluvial fan in north Bihar and causes floods, so it is called the Sorrow of Bihar.

new.s: Between which hills does the Pal Ghat gap lie?
new.x: Pal Ghat, about 24-30 km wide, lies between the Nilgiris in the north and the Anaimalai in the south.

new.s: Which is the highest point of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands?
new.x: Saddle Peak (732 m), near Diglipur in North Andaman, is the highest point of the islands.

new.s: Which region of India has the largest tidal energy potential?
new.x: The Gulf of Khambhat, with the Gulf of Kutch, has India's largest tidal energy area.

new.s: Over which States do the Kaimur Hills extend?
o: Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar
new.x: The Kaimur Hills extend over Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.

new.s: Which is the southernmost hill range of the Western Ghats, closest to Kanyakumari?
new.x: The Cardamom Hills (Yela Mala) of Kerala-Tamil Nadu are the southernmost and include Agastyamalai.

new.s: Where does the Luni river rise?
new.x: The Luni rises in the Aravalli south-west of Ajmer, runs 511 km and is lost in the Rann of Kutch.

new.s: Which is the largest glacier of India?
new.x: Siachen in the Karakoram (Ladakh) is the largest and longest glacier in India.
